topic: Aokiji Let Robin Escape Ohara For Saul's Sake
title: Aokiji Let Robin Escape Ohara For Saul's Sake
description: Kuzan handed young Robin a boat during the Ohara Buster Call, but his stated reason was a friend, Jaguar D. Saul, and not the girl. A look at what chapters 397 and 1066 say about it. Who do you think Aokiji was really protecting?
comment: Did Aokiji spare Robin out of loyalty to Saul, or because he already doubted the Government?

lines.text: Aokiji never saved Nico Robin for Robin's sake.

shot.fallback: tall man with ice powers watching a small girl on a shore

lines.text: During the Buster Call on Ohara, he handed an eight-year-old a small boat and laid an ice trail across the sea.

shot.fallback: child in a small boat on a path of ice over dark water

lines.text: He even sabotaged the Marine ships that were about to chase her.

shot.fallback: frozen warships stuck in a sea at night

lines.text: Later he explained why. He respected Jaguar D. Saul's will, and felt it was his duty to watch over Robin.

shot.fallback: marine officer remembering a giant friend

lines.text: Here's the detail most people miss. His reason was never the girl. It was a friend.

shot.fallback: giant standing on a burning island shore

lines.text: And Kuzan didn't even know Saul had survived. Chapter 1066 shows the giant lived.

shot.fallback: giant reunited with a young woman in a library

lines.text: So he kept honoring a debt to a friend he assumed was lost.

shot.fallback: lone officer looking out at a calm sea

lines.text: People say it was just a soft spot for a child. But Kuzan named Saul himself.

shot.fallback: tall man leaning back in a chair, relaxed

lines.text: In chapter 397 he even called Sakazuki a fool for overdoing things, and I think he was right.

shot.fallback: two admirals facing each other on a ship deck

lines.text: But why was one little girl worth that risk? What was she carrying out of there?

shot.fallback: young girl clutching a bag on a boat

lines.text: Because the truth about that boat is this.

shot.fallback: small boat leaving a burning island

self_check.hook: Contrarian first line about Aokiji's real motive.
self_check.loop: Last line hands straight into line 1.
